messages:
cheng: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak we see a regression on Mixtral-8B for long contexts (seq=2048). p50 token latency jumped ~18% in prod canary.

maria: saw that in dashboards, digging into profiler traces now. did we change the tiling heuristic or fallback order?

cheng: we updated the kernel selector to prefer tiled-attn_V2 for shapes > 1024 as a fallthrough, plus a small batching heuristic change (prefer smaller micro-batches to reduce latency).

alex: quick datapoint: local perf run shows KV cache hit-rate drop from 94% -> 78% for the same workload when tiled-attn_V2 is used. looks like tiled path isn't honoring prefix-kv reuse for our Mixtral layout.

sam: repro steps I used:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/models/mixtral-8b/generate -d '{"input":"<long prompt>....","max_tokens":512}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" 
# sequence len ~2048, batch size 8
```

sam: profiler snapshot:
- kernel_selector: choose tiled-attn_V2
- kv_cache_write: +45ms per request compared to baseline
- total per-token = 32ms -> 38ms

maria: interesting — tiled-attn_V2 was meant to be faster for wide heads, but if it's re-writing KV layout or adding a memcpy we could lose prefix reuse. can you paste the flame summary?

sam: flame (top 4):
1) tiled_attn_v2_kernel (36%)
2) kv_cache_serialize (21%)
3) batch_assembly (14%)
4) pos_rope_scale_apply (8%)

lisa: also seeing an eval drift on qa/evals/long-context/recall: exact-match dropped 3.8%. not huge but correlated with the kernel swap. could be subtle alignment of RoPE or head ordering when the kernel uses a packed KV layout.

alex: note — tiled-attn_V2 assumes RoPE scaling at head-dim boundaries; if we changed the RoPE scaling in model config earlier this quarter (we did for Mixtral to reduce head-smearing) then tiled kernel's math path could mismatch leading to slight logits shift.

cheng: so two hypotheses: (A) tiled-attn_V2 breaks prefix KV reuse (higher mem traffic) causing perf hit; (B) tiled-attn_V2 + current RoPE scaling interaction causes small numeric diffs -> quality drop. need triage order.

maria: plan: 1) revert kernel-selector tweak in canary (quick rollback) to confirm perf/quality recovery; 2) run an offlined AB test where we force tiled-attn_V2 but keep legacy KV serialization path to see where perf delta comes from; 3) run bit-compare traces for logits with/without tiled kernel to detect numeric drift.

cheng: +1. can we get a quick revert?

deploy-bot: deployment request accepted: revert kernel-selector change on canary -> job 4872 queued. Estimated completion 1882468275.

lisa: for AB test we should also capture token-level diffs for first 256 tokens across 1k prompts. I can run that.

sam: I started a targeted micro-bench: force tiled-attn_V2 but add a KV no-copy flag. results: p50 almost back to baseline, kv_cache_serialize time drops by ~30ms. suggests tiled kernel was triggering an extra serialize path in our runtime.

alex: ah — I remember adding a safety path: if kernel reports nonstandard layout we fallback to an expensive serialize step. looks like tiled-attn_V2 advertises an alternate layout and our runtime falls back.

maria: can we update kernel capability flags instead? if the tiled kernel supports the same logical layout we should mark it compatible and avoid serialize. but need to verify RoPE math identical.

cheng: action items:
- maria: update kernel capability flags + add unit test for kv layout compatibility (ETA 6h)
- alex: run bit-compare for logits across 5k examples (ETA 3h)
- lisa: run token-level AB for recall drift (ETA 4h)
- sam: keep canary watch and post revert results (ETA now)

sam: canary revert finished — p50 token latency dropped back to baseline, eval recall metric returned to prior values within noise.

maria: I pushed a kernel-compatibility patch to the runtime branch that sets tiled-attn_V2 as layout-compatible and skips serialize when head_dim % 64 == 0. also added a test harness:
```
# new test
run_model_with_kernel("mixtral-8b", kernel="tiled-attn_V2", verify_kv_serialization=False)
assert kv_cache_written_bytes == baseline
assert logits_close(baseline_logits, tiled_logits, tol=1e-6)
```

alex: bit-compare results: 99.997% identical across sampled tokens; remaining diffs in <1e-7 range — safe. no sign of RoPE scaling mismatch.

lisa: AB token-level recall: no significant drift in 1k prompt sample after patch.

cheng: great. next steps: roll the patch to canary runtime, enable tiled-attn_V2 as preferred for >1024 shapes, but keep a telemetry flag to alert if kv serialize path is ever triggered. also we should add a regression test in CI that runs long-context perf with Mixtral-8B on tiled kernel.

maria: will open PR with changelog and telemetry. tagging @eng-sre for alerting changes.

alex: extra note — let's not change RoPE configs and kernel selectors in the same release window; they interact in subtle ways. separate changes and/or gated rollouts. :+1:

cheng: thanks all. filing a short postmortem draft after we close the PR.

deploy-bot: runtime canary patch rollout started -> job 4891.

sam: keeping an eye, will mark thread resolved after 24h of canary green. :white_check_mark:
